edits.rationale: MongoDB's paper frames performance testing as a signal-processing and change point detection problem, defined as detecting distributional changes in time-ordered observations. Its E-Divisive means is applied hierarchically and recursively until the largest candidate statistic falls below a significance threshold. The Hunter paper says it detects performance regressions and improvements.
